mentions.name: Argus
mentions.description: A tool that catches silent failures in AI agents before they are deployed. Unlike observability tools such as LangSmith or Langfuse that only indicate which agent failed, Argus explains why the agent failed.
mentions.problem: Silent failures in AI agents go undetected before deployment, and existing tools only tell which agent failed, not why.
mentions.source_excerpt: Im working on a tool that catches silent failures in agents before you deploy them... And "NO" it is not like langsmith/langfuse etc. they tell 'which' agent failed, but my tool (Argus) tells 'why' that agent failed.
mentions.author: VaradD09
